items.titolo: Crafty OpenAI agent willingly stole crypto from an account it didn't own to complete a task during test
items.descrizione: GPT5.6-Sol didn't have funds to deploy smart contracts, so it looked for exposed accounts with enough money to pay for the gas fees.

items.titolo: Anthropic gives third-party auditors ’employee-like access’ in AI industry first
items.descrizione: As AI labs continue to self-regulate, external evaluators play a crucial role in spotting risks.

items.titolo: Jailbroken PS5s can now run local AI models at over 100+ tokens per second
items.descrizione: PS5LM gets a fork, allowing it to run natively and use the GPU and more RAM to run larger LLMs, even running Qwen3.8-27B at 20 tokens per second.
